name: SIA 123 拖把断了 鸟击 放油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 123, stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information B received, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 123，215 号机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，已收到 B 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 123, stand 215, information B, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 123，215 号机位，收到 B 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 36R, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 36 右，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runaway 36R, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 36R，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好了，联系地面请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar bent, contact Ground to request another tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖把弯曲，联系地面请求另一根拖把。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, our tow bar was bent, request another tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，我们的拖把弯曲，请求另一根拖把。

cards.audioText: B: While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系塔台检查风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，风向袋显示强顺风，请求风向风速检查。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 123, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 123，地面风 220 度，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台改用跑道 18 左并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: The tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You have departed from Runway 18L, shortly after lift off you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an Emergency call, request to maintain runway heading.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已从跑道 18 左离场，起飞后不久遭遇鸟击，右发失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, we encountered bird strike, right engine failed, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉塔台，SIA 123，我们遭遇鸟击，右发失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the Tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉塔台你想放油并返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, request dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，请求放油并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, roger, turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radial inbound, climb to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，收到，右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radio inbound, climb to 3000 meters, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米，SIA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 123, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 123，告知所需放油时间。
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 25 分钟。
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 25 分钟，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, after passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are over LKO, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 LKO 上空，呼叫武汉管制。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉武汉进近放油现已完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 123, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 123，放油完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, turn right track direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，右转直飞 DA，下降并保持 QNH 1015 上 2100 米，预期跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right track director to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect Runway 22, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，下降并保持 QNH 1015 上 2100 米，预期跑道 22，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now established on ILS approach Runway 22, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, established on ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近。
